title: Formation Intervention and Post-Treatment Matching
user_goal: Advance the UCT experience-intelligence-self research from actual organization, with the current main line restricted to bodily/action-related familiarity and a genuinely installable formation/history intervention. Preserve C1 as the consciousness-specific explanatory postulate and keep organization, limited evidence, experience, judgment, conceptual self, and report distinct.
one_specific_open_question: Can an actual formation/history contrast support a residual action-familiarity judgment effect after motor ease, success, value, expectation, and source/agency feeling are matched, or does matching variables produced by formation either create a spurious contrast, destroy overlap, or block the organizational route that the contrast was meant to test?

fixed_sources_to_read: UCT I v1.2, especially C1 and self-experience distinctions
primary causal-inference sources on post-treatment conditioning and controlled versus total effects

planned_addition_or_correction: Specify an installability contract that separates pre-treatment nuisance matching from post-treatment mediators, give exact countermodels for collider-induced residual effects and route-blocking/positivity failure, and state what a surviving total formation effect would and would not support. Add only a disabled scoped application unless every formal adoption premise is actually discharged.
deliverable: An English research note, intervention contract, exact finite checks, claim and gap ledgers, source scope, formal-map audit, Chinese handoff, and dual persistence receipts. The deliverable must include a clear stop rule and a next experiment-level question rather than a phenomenal-identity claim.

direction_checks.after_selection: PASS_WITH_OPEN_BRIDGE: the question directly tests whether formation/history is an actual organizational contributor to experience-internal familiarity without making formation a basal-experience gate.
